KEENON presents multi-robot cleaning workflows at ISSA 2026

The exhibit combines floor-cleaning and delivery robots with a proposed role for XMAN-R1 clearing clutter before dedicated floor cleaners operate.

PR Newswire / KEENON Robotics ↗19 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Matching robots to building tasks

KEENON brought commercial cleaning robots, delivery robots and its XMAN-R1 humanoid to ISSA Show North America in Las Vegas, whose exhibit hall ran November 17–19. The presentation emphasized different robots sharing a facility rather than assuming one machine can perform every building-service task.

Different floors and facility sizes

The company positions KLEENBOT C55 for factories and warehouses, claiming a maximum cleaning rate of 2,376 square meters per hour with automatic water refilling and wastewater drainage. C40 combines sweeping and scrubbing, while C30 targets carpets. These are manufacturer specifications, not independently demonstrated rates across every site condition.

Humanoid assistance remains exploratory

KEENON describes a possible workflow in which XMAN-R1 clears clutter and tidies tabletops before C40 cleans larger floor areas. The exhibit also covers S300, T11, T10, T9 and W3 transport or hotel-service robots. The company calls humanoid-assisted cleaning an area it is exploring, so the proposal should not be read as a broadly proven commercial deployment.
